GPTR-F-001-S88.title: Request Schema and Contract Validation Layer
GPTR-F-001-S88.description: Define and enforce a strict request schema for all GPTReader inputs, ensuring collection, filters, projection, and limits conform to an explicit contract before entering allowlist enforcement.

GPTR-F-001-S89.title: Deterministic Allowlist Evaluation Engine
GPTR-F-001-S89.description: Implement deterministic evaluation logic that matches incoming requests against the allowlist (collections, fields, operators) and rejects any non-exact or partially matching queries with no fallback paths.

GPTR-F-001-S90.title: Standardized API Error Responses for Scope Violations
GPTR-F-001-S90.description: Implement consistent API responses for rejected requests, including structured error codes, messages, and no data leakage, ensuring client systems can reliably interpret enforcement failures.

GPTR-F-001-S91.title: Enforcement Decision Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S91.description: Log all enforcement decisions (allowed, rejected, reason codes, request metadata) to support QA validation, SIT traceability, and security auditing without exposing sensitive payload data.
